item.title: Oracle: LOT-003 export of isFavoritesOrRead and isRedFlagged (#268)
item.body:
Refs #268
Claim: mac/capture-batch

**Problem.** #306 (PR #332) reads the topic flag from the function bar. A differential test on the overlap with legacy needs legacy's `isFavoritesOrRead` and `isRedFlagged` (`HFRswift/Wrapped/MessagesTableViewController.m:1556-1583` at `2440d79`), which the LOT-003 oracle did not export. #268 also asks for the other settings values.

**Cause.** `-[MessagesTableViewController setupFastAnswer:]` sets them. That controller is compiled into the `SuperHFRplus` target only, not into the `HFRswift` test host (the export first tried to call it through the runtime: "not in the test host").

**What changed.**
- `hfrnow.patch` (superset of the previous one): `OracleObjCSafe.m` transliterates lines 1556-1583 on the real `HTMLParser`/`HTMLNode` calls, after `ParseMessagesOperation` ran on the same parser, as `startParseDataHtml:` does. Exported as `result.fastAnswer` `{isFavoritesOrRead, isRedFlagged, isUnreadable}`; documented in the LOT-003 spec.
- `Fixtures/LOT-003/`: the 21 oracles re-exported. Each one only gains `fastAnswer` (5 lines); the rest is byte-identical, and the map is unchanged.
- `Fixtures/LOT-003-flag/`: R33b, R61d, R61e, R63a, R63e, the logged-in captures with the bar link that `LOT-003/` lacked.
- `Fixtures/LOT-003-settings/`: R21 with `display_sig: yes`, `display_images: no`, `embedded_videos: no`; R26 with `display_sig: yes`; R28 with `display_images: no`, `embedded_videos: no`.
- Why separate folders: adding these cases to `LOT-003/` changes the case lists and corpus totals of the LOT-030..034 differential tests (seen: `MessageContentOracleTests` totals and `MessageQuoteOracleTests` fail). Those suites stay as they are.

**Result** (legacy, all 14 cases #332 lists):

| Captures | isFavoritesOrRead | isRedFlagged |
|---|---|---|
| R21, R32b | function-bar `delflag` link | true |
| P03m, R63a, R63e, R33b, R61d, R61e | function-bar `delflag` link | false |
| R20, R22a, R24, RA5 | `""` | false |
| RA1, RU2 | `nonlu` link (isUnreadable true) | false |

**Left on #268.** The deepest quote/tag nesting HFR serves needs a new capture, so it is not done here. That is why this PR says `Refs #268`.

**Checks.**
- `run-oracle.sh` on each of the three folders: `errors.json` is empty.
- `swift test` (HFRParsingTests): 423 tests pass.
- `anonymize.py check --config` (operator pseudos and ids) is clean on the 33 oracle files.
- An independent grep finds none of the `local.json` pseudos, e-mails, ids or own topics, and none of the account credentials.
- No `hash_check` value other than `REDACTED`, and no cookie value.

**Adversarial review (Sonnet, separate sub-agent) of head be841dfec9c862318a74c74c234750ea24736943: APPROVE.**

- **Transliteration.** It matches `setupFastAnswer:` (`MessagesTableViewController.m:1556-1583`): branch order, `HTMLNode.m:232-277` preorder/`strstr` semantics, defaults, and the call on the same parser after `parseData:`.
- **Values.** The reviewer recomputed `fastAnswer` for all 29 cases from the raw captures with its own parser. All of them are equal.
- **Patch.** It is a strict superset of the dev-swift patch and identical to the local legacy diff.
- **Re-exported LOT-003 oracles.** Each differs by the +5-line `fastAnswer` block only.
- **Settings variants.** They really carry the settings (signatures present, image wrappers and video embeds gone).
- **Independent leak check.** Written from scratch, not the anonymizer's code. It scanned 35 JSON files with 9 needles from `local.json` and the credentials, and found **0 hits**. There is no `hash_check` value, no cookie, no e-mail, and every profile id is in the alias ranges. Every name is `userN` and appears in its capture.
- **Nits, no change.**
  - The PR body's "33 files" counts oracles plus maps.
  - The spec cites the flag lines (1556) rather than the method start (1544), on purpose.
  - A fresh `isUnreadable` per page is correct for a per-page oracle.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

**Adversarial review round 2 (Sonnet sub-agent) of head 65827e3c7d1ba1640ab635471352ead1e2689c16: APPROVE, no finding.** The delta, which is spec wording only, matches the exporter. `OracleExportTopic.swift` sets `result["fastAnswer"]` from the normal-mode parse before the filter branch, and `filterMode` never carries it.
